findings.title: GET /api/search route unregistered in app.ts — 5 tests will fail
findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts, register in app.ts with app.use('/api', searchRouter)

findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and platform/ — false green on every run
findings.recommendation: Extend source_dirs to ['Source', 'portal', 'platform', 'E2E']. Add configurable enforcer_target from inspector.config.yml.

findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts (FR-dependency-metrics)
findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDurationHistogram export to metrics.ts. Instrument hasUnresolvedBlockers() in services/dependency.ts.

findings.title: FR-070–095 image-upload features implemented without a Specification file (spec-first violation)
findings.recommendation: Create Specifications/image-upload.md with domain model (ImageAttachment entity, upload rules, storage contract, API shape).

findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage inflate coverage
findings.recommendation: Delete root-level duplicates. Promote tests/pages/ versions as canonical.

findings.title: path-to-regexp <0.1.13 — Regular Expression Denial of Service (CVSS 7.5)
findings.fix: Update via express/framework upgrade. Verify path-to-regexp >=0.1.13 in lock files.

findings.title: picomatch <2.3.2 or 4.0.0–4.0.3 — ReDoS + prototype pollution (CVSS 7.5, dev-only)
findings.note: Dev dependency — build/dev environment risk only

findings.title: @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentations — Prometheus endpoint crash on malformed requests (CVSS 7.5)
FR-TMP-008 (Dockerfile.worker prereqs) has no # Verifies: traceability comment
findings.recommendation: Add # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 to the relevant Dockerfile.worker RUN instruction.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer uses mtime-based plan selection — non-deterministic
findings.recommendation: Add enforcer_target to inspector.config.yml; make enforcer prefer configured target over mtime.

findings.title: Specifications/workflow-engine.md has no formal FR-XXX IDs — traces to Plan, not Spec
findings.recommendation: Add FR-WF-* table to workflow-engine.md or move plan FR table into the spec.

findings.title: FR-dependency-seed not implemented in Source/
findings.recommendation: Verify portal/ seed coverage. If Source/ needs seeding, create Source/Backend/src/seed.ts.

findings.title: DebugPortalPage.tsx uses non-standard // Verifies: comment (no FR-XXX ID)
findings.recommendation: Replace with a formal FR-XXX ID or document why no requirement applies.

findings.title: 2 eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without documented justification
findings.recommendation: Add comments explaining why the dep is intentionally excluded to prevent stale-closure bugs.

findings.title: vite <=6.4.1 — path traversal in optimised deps .map handling (dev-only)
findings.note: Dev dependency — risk limited to development environment

findings.title: esbuild <=0.24.2 — CORS bypass on dev server (CVSS 5.3, dev-only)
findings.fix: Update via vite update (esbuild is bundled with vite)
findings.note: Dev dependency — risk limited to development environment

findings.title: brace-expansion <1.1.13 — process hang on zero-step sequences (CVSS 6.5)
findings.fix: Transitive update via minimatch or glob updates

escalations.title: protobufjs <=7.5.5 — Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs to >=7.5.6 in both locations. Verify with npm audit.
escalations.impact: Arbitrary code execution in orchestrator and portal/Backend processes
escalations.reason_for_escalation: Arbitrary code execution — critical security vulnerability requiring TheGuardians security validation before deployment

escalations.title: handlebars 4.0.0–4.7.8 — JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars to >=4.7.9. Identify and pin transitive chain root. Audit all Handlebars template usage.
escalations.impact: Server-side JavaScript execution in Source/Backend context
escalations.reason_for_escalation: JavaScript injection in template engine — critical vulnerability requiring TheGuardians security validation before deployment

grading.rationale: 3 P1 findings exceeds the C-grade threshold of max_p1=2 defined in inspector.config.yml. Two P1s are critical CVEs (CVSS 9.8) escalated to TheGuardians; one is an unimplemented required route with 5 documented test failures.
